01Another project showed that a skilled client working with a specialist company can achieve an excellent result.

Another project showed that a skilled client working with a specialist company can achieve an excellent result. The customer wanted the treatment plant supplied by our company, but decided to carry out the building work himself. Thanks to his practical skills, he handled all the groundworks and preparation to a very high standard, saving himself part of the cost.

Our technicians then provided installation supervision, professional commissioning of the technology and the documentation needed for the final procedures with the authorities. The client also received proper training, including an explanation of the operating modes and how to run the plant correctly.

02The outcome was clear – the plant worked from day one, the client could be sure the technology…

The outcome was clear – the plant worked from day one, the client could be sure the technology was running as it should, and both sides came away satisfied. This case shows that DIY can make sense when it is combined with professional installation and commissioning by specialists.
